levels.surface: حمزة بن عبد الله بن عمر

notes: Group 2 («وزاد عبد الله») is a second route carrying the addition of the same report; the text names nothing after ابن أبي جعفر, so the route stops there
Group 3 («وقال معلى حدثنا وهيب») is a full second isnad for the same matter (rule 4), not a remark, so not variant
«ابن أبي جعفر» is not merged with «عبيد الله بن أبي جعفر»: the text does not write them as one man in succession; «أخي الزهري» is an epithet, left out
